'''Steven Lewis Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operations Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operations Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operation.txt |Download]]

'''Character'''
* 2x [[Wedge Antilles]]
* 1x [[Toryn Farr]]
* 2x [[Arcona]]
* 2x [[Figrin D'an]]
* 2x [[Leesub Sirln]]
* 3x [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)]]
* 2x [[R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo)]]
* 4x [[Correllian Corvette]]
* 1x [[Did We Get Into This Mess" to cycle through your deck and pull up your locations]]

* 6x [[X-wing]]

* 1x [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]]

'''Vehicle'''
* 1x [[Tauntaun]]
